default_behavior: decompose non-trivial work; use one local task for small focused work
small_task_behavior: one compact local task unless an expansion trigger fires
decomposition_order: classify authorization actions profile scale facts areas and risk
split by changed fact owner contract area dependency validation and support sync
assign exactly one implementation level to each task
select primary worker suggestion-only or blocked executor
attach bounded context non-goals scope validation and acceptance
primary reconciles facts approvals validation docs diagrams support and risk

levels.name: read-only-analysis
use_when: inspection evidence issue review status recommendations
levels.quality_gate: report evidence uncertainty and no edits

levels.name: documentation-or-support-update
use_when: bounded docs adapter prompts gates diagrams or generated-reference sync

levels.name: tests-or-validation
use_when: test checker fixture validation or failure evidence
levels.quality_gate: do not hide defects or weaken contracts

levels.name: bounded-implementation
use_when: settled design bounded code known owner objective validation

levels.name: coherent-change-package
use_when: code tests docs diagrams support approvals or multiple surfaces
levels.quality_gate: global integrity review over combined repair

levels.name: architecture-or-business-decision
use_when: accepted behavior architecture ownership source-of-truth contract security
levels.quality_gate: accepted facts require owner and approval before implementation

levels.name: protected-external-or-publication-action
use_when: commit push deploy destructive live external credential permission spend migration release
levels.quality_gate: recheck newest authorization and scoped approval

selection_order: primary for semantic decision approval conflict convergence and protected actions
verified worker for bounded ready subtasks allowed by level and role
suggestion-only when capability exists conceptually but execution is unavailable or not trusted
blocked when owner authorization approval validation or context is missing
executor_selection.fallback: continue primary or ask when capability authorization approval or validation is unresolved

final_evidence: task IDs levels dependencies and executor decisions
context selected and omitted per task
worker packet and result IDs when delegation was used
delegation tree depth coverage budget child proposals and stop reasons
escalations residual risk and measured cost or latency
review_triggers: delegated work caused rework validation failure or drift
areas owners validation or support relationships changed
